_: THE THERMALS — heights_2. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/heights_2.json
One capture per screen and per set-piece, in route order: the scree, the cold
__: climb, the gallery and its treads, the hall and the launch, then the canyon's
___: curtain / thermal / lane / island / flue, the cellar, and the exit terrace.

_: GOTCHAS. A teleport puts the top-left of the body on the tile's top-left, so
__: her feet land inside the row below: aim one row ABOVE the row she should stand
___: on. Teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture lands
____: on the hub, so the last shot stands one tile short of it.

_: SCREEN C (0,1) — THE SCREE. The only walked ground in the level: spawn, the
__: two tiles of heights_vent in the floor, and the pad_bird at the chimney's foot.
___: settle 210, not 90: the level-title card is still up at 90 and covers the room.

_: The vent pit, hopped. Two tiles, which the human clears at LIMITS 3 with a
__: tile to spare; there is rock under the vents, so falling in costs a heart.

_: THE COLD CHIMNEY. Stand on the pad_bird to become the bird with a full bar,
__: then mash jump for 45 frames: the HUD's stamina bar is the set-piece. Measured,
___: the whole 14-tile climb is 1.82 s and 75 of the 100 stamina.

_: SCREEN A (0,0) — THE GALLERY. The chimney's head is capped; the way out is
__: east, two tiles of it, onto the floor that is also the oasis. Dropped a row
___: high onto the pad_frog tile so she falls into its box and transforms.

_: THE CREVICE. Three treads, stand 13 -> 10 -> 7 -> 6, and the frog's measured
__: apex is 5.34 tiles, so a 3-tile rise is the kit's limit rather than a guess.
___: Standing on the lower tread, jumping for the upper one.

_: THE HALL and THE LIP. pad_bird at (20,6) is a full bar by construction, and
__: the rock lip at cols 23-24 is the launch: standing at col 24 her centre is
___: x=389, so the screen flip happens three tiles out over the canyon.

_: SCREEN B (1,0) — THE CURTAIN. Sinking air, cols 25-27. Mashing jump inside it
__: sets vel.y to -2 px/s: measured best gain 0.00 tiles, so she goes down whatever
___: she does, and the thermal east of her is what gives the altitude back.

_: THE THERMAL, from the canyon side: no input at all, 182 px/s of free lift,
__: overshooting its lip by 3.28 tiles into the gust lane at rows 5-7.

_: THE LANE, downwind. gust_right is [80,0] against the bird's 104, so the
__: target is 184 px/s eastbound and 24 westbound — ten tiles in 1.12 s.

_ride: Twenty frames of move_right and no jump: long enough for the push to
__ride: read on the velocity (0.33 s is the run's whole ramp at air_accel 560) and
___ride: short enough that she is still inside the three-row lane. Mashing jump here
____ride: climbs OUT of the lane and loses the gust, which the first capture showed.

_: THE ISLAND. Three tiles of basalt at stand row 8, under the lane: the oasis
__: in the middle of the crossing, 0 to full in 1.27 s on the ground.

_: THE FLUE, cols 41-44: the same downdraft tile as the curtain, and the dive
__: into the cellar. Flapping flat out on the way in and still going down — this
___: is the door that shuts behind her and makes the return a different chain.
____: Dropped INSIDE the column at row 11: at row 9 she is above its top row and
_____: climbs out, which is the opposite of the thing being shown, and at row 13
______: she sinks to the bottom edge of the screen where the capture cannot see her.

_: SCREEN D (1,1) — THE CELLAR. Roof of rock with two holes in it, the heart at
__: the flue's foot, and the floor broken by four tiles of vent at cols 35-38.

_: The cellar's own wind: gust_left at rows 25-26, so the return leg runs west
__: at 184 px/s where the canyon ran east. Over the broken floor to the oasis
___: shelf at cols 32-34, which sits against the thermal's throat.

_: THE THERMAL from below: 22 tiles from the cellar floor to the flight lane,
__: for nothing. A mashed bar buys 21.1, and the roof has no other hole.

_: THE TERRACE. The exit at (46,6), reached by flying east over the mouth of the
__: flue. Standing one tile east of it: teleporting onto the exit tile ends the
___: level and the capture would land on the hub.
